text: FaceTheCamera is an AI teleprompter designed for confident business video communication.
The project was created by Rundong Li.
The funding goal for FaceTheCamera was US$ 15,000.
FaceTheCamera raised US$ 3,561 from 15 backers.
The funding period for FaceTheCamera was from December 4, 2025, to January 13, 2026.
The project funding was unsuccessful.
FaceTheCamera aims to assist founders, executives, sales teams, marketers, recruiters, and content professionals in delivering clear and confident on-camera messages.
The project emphasizes the importance of clear and natural speaking on camera for professional communication.
FaceTheCamera can be used for various business communication scenarios, including investor pitches, CEO updates, sales outreach, and client presentations.
FaceTheCamera helps founders, executives, sales teams, marketers, recruiters, and content professionals deliver clear, confident, and credible on-camera messages.
FaceTheCamera can be used for investor and fundraising pitches, CEO updates, sales outreach, marketing explainers, recruiting messages, internal training, and personal branding content.
FaceTheCamera includes features such as script reading and real-time AI eye-contact correction.
FaceTheCamera aims to help users present naturally and deliver polished, professional video messages.
Recording a business video is often stressful, awkward, and time-consuming for most professionals.
One challenge for business professionals is losing structure and clarity mid-message without a clear script flow.
The project is called FaceTheCamera, which is an AI teleprompter designed for confident business video.
Rundong Li is associated with the FaceTheCamera project.
One challenge addressed by FaceTheCamera is losing structure and clarity mid-message.
Another challenge is the obvious eye movement when reading from a screen, which can break trust.
FaceTheCamera aims to reduce the use of filler words and improve delivery under pressure.
The project addresses the challenge of speaking too fast, too slow, or over time without a guided script pace.
FaceTheCamera seeks to prevent missing or under-emphasizing key points in a message.
The project also aims to mitigate tense facial expressions on camera, which can affect perceived confidence.
Nervousness can manifest as stiffness, tight smiles, and strained expressions, affecting how investors, clients, and colleagues perceive your credibility, clarity, and leadership on camera.

FaceTheCamera includes six AI-driven tools to help users appear confident, credible, and natural on camera.
The Teleprompter feature of FaceTheCamera allows users to deliver clear, structured business messages without memorizing lines.

The Eye Contact AI feature of FaceTheCamera keeps users' eyes focused directly toward the camera while reading their script.

PaceControl allows users to set their ideal video length and guides their speaking pace.
PaceControl ensures that messages fit exact time windows, keeping pitches clear and easy to watch.
KeyPoint Highlights AI identifies critical phrases in scripts and subtly highlights them while speaking.
KeyPoint Highlights helps users emphasize important points naturally without breaking their flow.
Expression Ease AI softens tense facial expressions and stabilizes micro-movements.
Expression Ease helps users appear relaxed, calm, and trustworthy during presentations.

Coaches, Consultants & Content Creators use FaceTheCamera for personal branding videos, educational content, social clips, and thought-leadership messages.

The product concepts, UX flows, and interface designs for FaceTheCamera were created manually by the team.
The teleprompter system in FaceTheCamera is built using integrated open-source React teleprompter components.
The interface, scrolling behavior, and overlay controls of the teleprompter system were customized by the team.
The teleprompter module does not rely on AI and is powered entirely by standard front-end technology.
FaceTheCamera uses Microsoft Azure Video APIs and NVIDIA Maxine for real-time face tracking and head stabilization.
The Smart Eye Contact & Head Stabilization feature helps users maintain natural eye contact and camera presence.
The AI tools used for face tracking and head stabilization analyze visual data to stabilize gaze and head movement.
The FluentVoice module uses the OpenAI Realtime API and Whisper Flow for real-time speech recognition and cleanup.
The FluentVoice module detects filler words and regenerates smoother audio based on the user's original voice recording.
The output of the FluentVoice module remains 100% human, with AI functioning only as a clarity and fluency filter.
The Expression Relaxation AI feature, powered by NVIDIA Maxine, gently reduces facial tension to help users appear calm and confident.
Adjustments made by the Expression Relaxation AI occur in real time and do not generate or replace any part of the user's face or expressions.
Expression Relaxation AI is powered by NVIDIA Maxine and reduces facial tension to help users appear calm and confident.
